ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has two summer corn sowing date isoline maps for 1970 and 2000, and the isoline values are approximately 130, 140, 150, 160, etc. Places 1 and 2 are roughly within a similar latitude range; place 1 is located in the western inland part of the figure, and the surrounding isolines have obvious bending and show a closed form; place 2 is located to the east, near the eastern plain or coastal area, and the nearby isolines are relatively gentle. Then reason: The two places have similar latitudes, but the sowing date isolines differ obviously, indicating that besides the influence of atmospheric circulation, there are also differences in local natural conditions. The isolines near place 1 are closed and obviously bent, showing the controlling effect of terrain on heat and sowing time, so the second main factor causing the different summer corn sowing dates at places 1 and 2 is terrain and topography.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：比较1、2两点在两幅图上的位置和周围等值线，发现二者纬度相近，但1地附近等值线闭合、弯曲，2地在东部平原/沿海一带，等值线形态较平缓。再结合题干说明要找造成两地播种日期不同的两个主要因素中的第二个。由于同纬度附近播期差异明显，且图上1地所在区域表现出明显的地形控制特征，可判定除大气环流外，另一主要因素是地形地势。
